description: Open an http(s) URL in the current tab. Returns evidence and a snapshot of the visible screen (elements carry refs like e12), with counts of what is above and below. Words like cheapest, latest, highest-rated or most mean the site's own sort or tab for that order (a list's default order is usually something else, e.g. 'Best' or 'Featured'): apply it, then read the top. Over several sites, finish one and note the values the next needs before opening it.

snapshot.description: Default true. false: no page snapshot, only what happened (title, counts). Only when this same reply also reads the page with browser_query and you will not act on it; keep it for a page you have not seen or whose tabs, sorts, filters or forms you may use.

name: browser_navigate
title: Open a URL
